scope: Notes ordinary-member native acceptance login only; no product, account, role, Store, vault, or organization mutation

input_contract.mode: NOTES_ROLE=member with NOTES_MEMBER_CREDENTIAL_FILE pointing to an existing authorized private JSON file
input_contract.shape: Exactly email and password string fields
input_contract.privacy: File must be a regular file owned by the runner uid, mode 0600, opened with O_NOFOLLOW; the email SHA-256 prefix must match reviewer_email_fingerprint in NOTES_PRIVATE_CONFIG
input_contract.manual_alternative: NOTES_INTERACTIVE_MEMBER=1 remains available and is mutually exclusive with NOTES_MEMBER_CREDENTIAL_FILE

source_behavior: The runner opens the exact https://www.aimatrx.com/login destination, fills the real login form, waits for the real site session and /api/whoami identity, then verifies the extension Account identity and the canonical admin table empty-row proof. Reports and thrown credential errors use fixed codes and contain no credential value.

verification.static_syntax: node --check on the three changed .mjs files passed
verification.unit: Four synthetic node:test cases passed under the exact resource-guard command. Run notes-private-credential-unit-20261002-01 had RESOURCE_ADMITTED, child exit 0, and RESOURCE_FINAL_DECISION valid (resourceInvalid false). Journal: docs/stabilization/resource-journals/notes-private-credential-unit-20261002-01.jsonl
verification.native: not run in this lane; no actual private credential was read

remaining: A separately authorized fresh native member run must supply an existing permitted private fixture after credential remediation. Successful source checks do not establish real login, Notes behavior, or defect closure.
